# docsrs-cli

> One-shot stdin/stdout CLI for crates.io and docs.rs documentation for LLM agents.

docsrs-cli is a born-execute-finalize-die binary that searches crates, fetches README overviews and typed rustdoc items, and emits stable JSON envelopes on stdout with diagnostics only on stderr.

## Primary Documentation

- [README](README.md): product landing page, install, commands, env vars
- [How to use](docs/HOW_TO_USE.md): first command in 60 seconds
- [Agents](docs/AGENTS.md): agent integration contract and economy

- [Cross platform](docs/CROSS_PLATFORM.md): OS matrix and XDG paths
- [Migration](docs/MIGRATION.md): version migration notes
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run categorized tests
- [JSON schemas](docs/schemas/README.md): machine-readable payload contracts

- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): Keep a Changelog history
